Bug Report: Critical Server/Client Hang due to Invalid RPD Slot

Environment:

SPT Version: 4.0.0 (and potentially newer)

Mod Name: BlackDivServer

Related Mods: SAIN (interacts with bot loadouts)

Issue Description: The game client hangs indefinitely at the “Patching” stage or crashes during bot generation with a critical server error. The console logs indicate a slot mismatch for the RPD machine gun. Error Log: [Error][SPTarkov.Server.Core.Generators.BotEquipmentModGenerator] Slot: ‘mod_scope_001’ does not exist for weapon: weapon_zid_rpd_762x39 with id: 66e718dc498d978477e0ba75 for bot: blackdivassault Cause: In the mod’s database (db/ModBotLoadouts/Armory/.sptids), the weapon weapon_zid_rpd_762x39 (ID: 66e718dc498d978477e0ba75) has a mod_scope_001 slot defined. However, in the base SPT 4.0.0 (EFT 0.14+) files, the RPD model does not have a native scope slot. Attempting to force-attach a scope to this weapon during bot generation (specifically for the blackdivassault preset) causes the BotEquipmentModGenerator to fail, leading to memory leaks, system hangs, and corrupted server cache. Steps to Reproduce: Install BlackDivServer on SPT 4.0.0. Attempt to start a raid or load a profile where the blackdivassault bot preset is generated. The server/client will hang due to the invalid weapon configuration. Suggested Fix: Remove the mod_scope_001 entry from the weapon_zid_rpd_762x39 block in the mod’s weapon/armory database files. Ensure that RPD loadouts do not attempt to mount optics without the required dust cover/mount mods being present and correctly slotted.

The mod’s downloaded BepInEx and SPT need to be placed on both the client and the host (headless) side. https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/addon/34/black-div-spawn-notifier

If you are using “AI Limit”, this mod may prevent the Black Division from reaching you, possibly freezing it until you get close enough for the mod to activate the bot. This happens because “AI Limit” serves to preserve your computer’s memory, freezing the bots within a radius set as a default by the mod, which can be adjusted with F12, but depending on the distance it may cause lag.
